news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Alec Pierce (heel) good to go for Sunday
news.desc: Alec Pierce (heel) will be good to go for Sunday night's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Pierce missed Indianapolis' practice on Thursday, but it looks like that was just for injury maintenance, as he was back and a full participant for them at practice on Friday. He carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will play on Sunday night, although it remains quite possible that he will continue to have minor limitations while the team ramps his workload back up.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) active for Week 2
news.desc: Anthony Richardson Sr. (groin) will be active for Sunday night's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.impact: Richardson is going to be active for the Colts on Sunday night, so his groin injury is likely considered nothing more than a minor issue at this point. He will continue to serve as the QB2 for this team behind Daniel Jones.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) set to play Sunday
news.desc: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: Neither of DeJean's injuries are serious at this point and he goes into the weekend without an injury designation. He will continue to play a big role on Philadelphia's defense moving forward, assuming he suffers no setbacks with his recovery.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play Sunday
news.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) won't play play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: The veteran edge rusher is going to be out this week, despite taking part at practice all week. He should return to the lineup and provide a nice boost to Philly's pass rush sometime in the near future.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jalen Carter (wrist) available to play Sunday
news.desc: Jalen Carter (wrist) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense gets some good news ahead of Sunday's game, with Carter receiving full clearance to play against the Titans. He should continue to be a game-wrecker in what projects to be an easy matchup against Tennessee's low-powered offense.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Daron Payne (knee) cleared to play Sunday
news.desc: Daron Payne (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: Payne now has full clearance to play in Sunday's game against the Cowboys, which was to be expected after he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. Look for his presence to make a positive impact on Washington's defensive front in this matchup and beyond.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Ladd McConkey (ribs) questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders due to a rib injury.
news.impact: McConkey was a DNP Wednesday and Thursday but got back on the practice field Friday. His chances to play are more on the slim side, but if he plays, you need to start him against this Raiders defense. If he sits, Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris are next in line for targets.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Javon Kinlaw (back) officially questionable for Sunday
news.desc: Javon Kinlaw (back) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.impact: Kinlaw returned to practice on Friday and will officially be questionable to play in Washington's matchup against Dallas on Sunday. Their defensive front will be a little short on depth if he is ruled out ahead of kickoff for this game.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Odafe Oweh (calf) available to play Sunday
news.desc: Odafe Oweh (calf) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: As expected, Oweh is going to be available to play through his minor calf injury on Sunday. The team will need him to step up and help anchor down the defensive front in what projects to be a tough matchup against the Cowboys.

news.author: Leo Sells
news.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) good to go for Sunday
news.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Dallas Cowboys.
news.impact: A groin injury left Lane limited at practice all week, but it's not a serious issue and won't affect his availability for Sunday's game against Dallas. He doesn't project to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
